notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Pestilence Demon lifelink.
Your life total is at least 3.
description:
Give Pestilence Demon lifelink by any method.
Activate Pestilence Demon by paying 2 life, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player and causing you to gain life equal to the amount of damage dealt this way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.
